q: The Holevo bound limits the classical information accessible from a quantum ensemble {pᵢ,ρᵢ} to:
exp: Holevo (1973): the mutual information between a classical message X and any quantum measurement Y is bounded by the Holevo quantity χ = S(ρ̄) - ∑pᵢS(ρᵢ) where ρ̄=∑pᵢρᵢ. This bound is achievable (HSW theorem).
